# Colophon

![](img/headers/banner_man_standing_dna.png){.chapter-banner fig-alt="Colofon"}





This book was made possible by the kind help of Caspar J. van Lissa, who wrote an excellent instruction through an [example GitBook](https://cjvanlissa.github.io/gitbook-demo/){target="_blank"}.

The 2022 and 2024 editions of this book were produced in RStudio with the `bookdown` package; from the 2026 edition (version 3.0.0) the book is produced with [Quarto](https://quarto.org){target="_blank"}. <!-- PUBLISHING: Volume 107 of the Pinnacle was designed and produced by the 2013 Pinnacle -->
